limitations: Historical account status and plan changes are not retained; current eligible accounts are used as the validation cohort.
Account attribution is required for work scoring; unmatched or incomplete work is reported as unavailable evidence.
The metric scores account capacity drawdown, not a guarantee of future routing or provider behavior.
Only ready estimates are scored; saturation does not measure uncensored drawdown.
Held-out capacity error is evaluated separately from full-pool interruption timing; the historical request log cannot reproduce sticky-session allocation exactly.
Only seven-day quota observations are included; five-hour limits and purchased credits are excluded.
